title: Authorized review of one Lara formalization and its source binding
x-consumer-invariants: published as the document of an ara.attachment/v1 of kind review_attestation whose body.schema is ara.lara-review-attestation/v1; the attachment publisher equals reviewer and the attachment target equals target.contribution_id (an initial_payload attestation travels only inside the reviewed contribution's own payload)
reviewer holds authorized_reviewer in the ara.role-policy/v1 named by role_policy; otherwise the record is retained but supplies no review (unauthorized_reviewer)
reviewer differs from the binding producer and from the formalization author of every reviewed claim; otherwise the record is retained but supplies no review (self_review)

covered names the exact argument bytes, binding_id, policy file and registry_id reviewed, and native equals the binding's native snapshot; any change to a covered input makes the attestation inapplicable to the new version (stale_review); approval is never carried forward
reviewed is sorted by lara_claim and unique; each entry names a selected claim of the covered binding with its native selector

review covers whether the formal statement, numeric cells, assumptions and source references faithfully represent the selected evidence; it does not establish measurement correctness, reproduction, reviewer independence or ARA maturity

linkage 'supersedes' names the reviewer's own earlier attestation with the same target, native, covered inputs and reviewed claims; 'disputes' names another attestation and carries disposition disputed or rejected; both retain the earlier record and state the affected claims
a claim counts as audited only when a current approved attestation covers it and no current disputed or rejected attestation (and no open ara.dispute/v1 naming the approval) covers the same inputs
